name: Biological Sciences: Molecular Genetics (BMG) Track
notes: AP Biology (4/5) and IB Biology HL (6/7) earn general credit only - never major/minor requirements (encoded: apIbCreditExcluded).
UR courses must fulfill at least half the concentration requirements; ancillary-field courses are exempt (encoded: minPctFromHomeInstitution + per-group ancillary flags).
Maintain a 2.0 GPA within the major, excluding allied/ancillary field courses (encoded: minMajorGPA, checked against student-entered grades).

requirementGroups.label: Introductory biology
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: BIOL 110L/098: Principles of Biology I with Lab; BIOL 111L/099: Principles of Biology II with Lab

requirementGroups.label: Half lab (UPBM list)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: One half lab from UPBM laboratories list. BIOL 198P is highly recommended.
requirementGroups.note: NEEDS VERIFICATION: UPBM half-lab list not published inline; known half-labs modeled.

requirementGroups.label: Laboratory experience
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Plus one of the following options: BIOL 268 (usually junior year); BIOL 228A&B iGEM I&II; #### 395 (two courses)
requirementGroups.note: iGEM requires both 228A and 228B (pairing not auto-enforced); the two-395 alternative is not auto-modeled.

requirementGroups.label: Advanced core
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Both of the following: BIOL 202: Molecular Biology; BIOL 243: Eukaryotic Gene Regulation

requirementGroups.label: Advanced: biochemistry
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Plus one of the following: BIOL 250 & 250P: Biochemistry and Biochemistry Lab; BIOL 252
requirementGroups.note: BIOL 250 pairs with 250P per the page (pairing not auto-enforced).

requirementGroups.label: Advanced electives (2)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Plus two of the following advanced electives: BIOL 205; BIOL 210; BIOL 219L; BIOL 222; BIOL 226; BIOL 257L; BIOL 267; BIOL 278

requirementGroups.label: Diversification elective (1, outside BMG)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Select one course from the BMG diversification electives list.

requirementGroups.label: General chemistry
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Both of the following general chemistry courses: CHEM 131: Chemical Concepts I with Lab; CHEM 132: Chemical Concepts II with Lab

requirementGroups.label: Organic chemistry I (one path)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: One of the following organic chemistry I courses: CHEM 203/207: Organic Chemistry I with Lab; CHEM 171/173: First Year Organic Chemistry I with Lab
requirementGroups.note: Alternate-rigor paths - also enforced by the orgo-sequence equivalency group (mixing paths is flagged).

requirementGroups.label: Organic chemistry II (one path)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: One of the following organic chemistry II courses: CHEM 204/208: Organic Chemistry II with Lab; CHEM 172/208 or 210: First Year Organic Chemistry with Lab
requirementGroups.note: CHEM 172 may pair with CHEM 208 or CHEM 210 as its lab; modeled with 210.

requirementGroups.label: Physics I
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: One of the following physics I courses: PHYS 113: General Physics I with Lab; PHYS 121: Mechanics with Lab; PHYS 141: Mechanics (Honors) with Lab
requirementGroups.note: Alternate-rigor variants - also enforced by the intro-physics equivalency group.

requirementGroups.label: Physics II
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: One of the following physics II courses: PHYS 114: General Physics II with Lab; PHYS 122: Electricity and Magnetism with Lab; PHYS 142: Electricity and Magnetism (Honors) with Lab

requirementGroups.label: Calculus I
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: One of the following calculus I courses: MATH 141: Calculus I; MATH 161: Calculus IA; MATH 171Q: Honors Calculus I
requirementGroups.note: Page lists MATH 171Q; the catalog code is MATH 171. Only Calc I is required here (not the full sequence); the calc-sequence equivalency group still prevents mixing paths.

requirementGroups.label: Calculus II
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: One of the following calculus II courses: MATH 142: Calculus II; MATH 162: Calculus IIA; MATH 172Q: Honors Calculus II
requirementGroups.note: Page lists MATH 172Q; catalog code MATH 172.

requirementGroups.label: Ancillary elective (1)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Math: MATH 164, 165, 235 or other upper-level math with advisor approval (MATH 143 is not acceptable); Statistics: STAT AP, 180, 190, 201 or other upper-level statistics course with advisor approval (STAT 211 is not acceptable); Computer programming: CSC 161, 170, 171, ECE 114 or other computer programming course with advisor approval
requirementGroups.note: "Other courses with advisor approval" are not auto-modeled; MATH 143 and STAT 211 are not acceptable.

upperLevelWriting.label: Two ULW courses (biological/natural sciences)
upperLevelWriting.sourceQuote: All biology majors must complete two ULW courses. ... Writing courses within the humanities and social sciences cannot be applied to the biology major.
upperLevelWriting.note: Department-scoped filter: one natural-sciences W course outside these departments may count with adviser permission (CHEM 210W for biochemistry majors); humanities/social-science W courses never count.
